was added to Oppenheimer's Top Picks list on Thursday, as the investment firm said it has "grown more constructive" on its position in artificial intelligence, sales execution, and potential to boost annual recurring revenue.

"We see support as: (1) Dynatrace's enterprise customers start to ramp AI production workloads and more focus is put on frontier model/AI-natives; (2) the Arize acquisition fills gaps in Dynatrace's AI portfolio, giving it an end-to-end solution for ML/LLMs/AI agents; (3) the sales motion expands to better address PLG growth, while strike teams drive logs use/consumption; and (4) the DPS renewal base expands, creating a lever for NNARR growth. Importantly, management remains careful with guidance, embedding conservatism and minimal AI contribution, suggesting upside as sales execution improves, and creating a path to >20% growth," analyst Ittai Kidron wrote in a note to clients.
Kidron reiterated his Outperform rating on Dynatrace and upped his price target on the stock to $71 from $60.

title: Dynatrace added to Top Picks at Oppenheimer
